Positive Money: Could These 3 Simple Changes to Banking Fix the Economy?

TL/DR

The Positive Money campaign seeks to have the government spend money into the economy, rather than give it first to banks who then lend it into the (wrong parts of) the economy.

For example, after the banking crisis in 2007, the UK government had the Bank of England create £375 Billion to stimulate the economy. This money should have been spent on infrastructure projects, for example, which would have put the funds into the real economy. Instead, the money was put into the markets, to raise share prices(most people don't have many shares), in the (vain) hope that a new sense of financial well being would trickle down into the economy.

The videos on the website are fascinating.

So, what are the 3 changes needed?

  • Take away power of banks to create money (The funds they create are not credit, as they are government backed)
  • Create Money free of debt
  • Newly created money must enter real economy first, before entering property bubbles and share speculation.
